plugins.name: one-shot
plugins.description: Activate one-shot mode: a decider subagent answers clarifying questions on your behalf so you are not interrupted during design or implementation.

plugins.name: gh-read
plugins.description: Read-only GitHub API proxy. Forces GET and an endpoint allowlist so Claude Code cannot mutate GitHub state.

plugins.name: public-ready
plugins.description: Pre-publication scan for the current repo. Flags secrets (via gitleaks) and personal/internal info (via Claude) in content that would become public on the next push.

plugins.name: session-review
plugins.description: Retrospect on the just-completed session and propose CLAUDE.md updates + skill candidates that would help future sessions.

plugins.name: notes
plugins.description: Second-brain notes for a Markdown/Obsidian folder. /note jots a thought to its own file; /read-note finds and reads a note you already have; /daily-notes-add-title gives bare yyyy-mm-dd daily notes a descriptive title.

plugins.name: playwright-cli
plugins.description: Browser automation through the playwright-cli command: navigate pages, fill forms, snapshot and screenshot, mock requests, and verify frontend changes.
